extension.summary: Explicit local H.264/AAC CrystalHD YUY2 prototype
extension.description: Optional Kodi 22 RC1 format-admission experiment. Progressive H.264 MP4 via crystalhddec, two host copies into Kodi YUY2 buffers; mono/stereo AAC via Kodi. Not negotiated packed-format support, ordinary-file interception or a performance/physical A/V acceptance claim.
